messages:
Alex: I'm oncall tonight 18:00-02:00 PT. Quick pre-checks before handoff — can folks confirm VPN access, pager provisioning, runbook link, and whether any creds expire during shift? Also saw the batch-worker autoscale tweak earlier, FYI could surface CPU spikes around 19:00.

Priya: Confirming pager is provisioned for the oncall group. I'll send a test now.

sre-bot: Pager test sent to #oncall-group at 2024-07-28T17:55:12Z — delivery OK :white_check_mark:

Jordan: Alex — VPN group membership looks fine. You should be added to `eng-oncall-vpn` already. To double-check from a workstation run: `id -nG $(whoami)` or look in Okta > Groups > eng-oncall-vpn.

Alex: Thanks. Can someone paste the runbook link? Want to pin it to my notes.

Priya: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/standard-handoff (check the 'pre-oncall checklist' section). Also note: the temporary AWS session creds for the prod role that the infra team issued expire 2024-07-28T20:30:00Z — you'll need to refresh if you plan to do any long-running debugging after 20:15. Use `aws-vault exec redwood-prod -- aws sts get-caller-identity` to verify.

Jordan: Small config note — we rolled a conservative scale-down on batch workers at 18:00 to reduce cost; it may cause backlog growth if a big job starts. If you see sustained queue depth > 500, hit the console toggle: Console -> Infra -> BatchWorkers -> Overrides -> revert-scale-down (or run `rbacctl feature-toggle batch.revert_scale_down`). I left a short rollback play in the runbook under 'Known risks'.

Alex: OK I'll run quick smoke after I finish connecting: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.internal/health || echo "healthcheck failed"` and post results. If pager test hits me and I can't reach VPN, I'll ping from my phone.

Priya: Pager test again coming in 2m to verify mobile delivery. Also granted temporary SSH bastion access until 02:15 PT for escalation.

sre-bot: Pager test delivered to Alex via SMS at 2024-07-28T17:58:03Z.

Alex: Got it — SMS landed. Healthcheck: all OK (200). I'll keep an eye on batch queues and escalate if queue depth climbs. Thanks for the heads-up and the creds refresh reminder.

Jordan: One more thing — if you need to escalate to infra, call Victor (oncall infra) or create a high-priority incident in PagerDuty; his contact is in the runbook. Good luck! :thumbsup:

Priya: all set from my side. enjoy the shift. :coffee:
